videos.description:

videos.title: This Board Is Named After a Bar #shorts
videos.description:
Arduino is named after a bar in Ivrea, Italy, and that bar is named after Arduin of Ivrea, King of Italy from 1002. Here's how a cheap, open-source board for design students became the standard for makers.
